title: A corrupt recent-subscriber order record is treated as missing without a log
current: The recent-subscriber order parser returns undefined both for a legacy post with no record and for a record that exists but fails JSON parsing or validation; the second case is silent.
evidence: The catch carries 'diagnostic-allow-silent: legacy posts do not have an ordering record'. A present but unreadable value also lands in this catch, so corruption looks the same as a legacy post.
required: Keep the silent path for a missing value; log a warn (without user data) when a value exists but can't be parsed.

criticality.why: Ordering of the recent-subscriber list could be wrong without anyone knowing, but no data is lost.
